description: This file defines memory allocation functions and structures for the hiredis library, including function pointers for custom allocators and inline functions for memory management.

methods.name: hiredisSetAllocators
methods.description: Sets custom memory allocators for hiredis.

methods.name: hiredisResetAllocators
methods.description: Resets to default memory allocators for hiredis.

methods.name: hi_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory using the configured malloc function.

methods.name: hi_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory using the configured calloc function, with overflow check.

methods.name: hi_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory using the configured realloc function.

methods.name: hi_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string using the configured strdup function.

methods.name: hi_free
methods.description: Frees memory using the configured free function.
